name: area51-have-doughnut.pdf
description: Declassified 1969 Foreign Technology Division/DIA tactical evaluation report (Project HAVE DOUGHNUT, Vol. II, FTD-CR-20-13-69-INT) comparing a captured Soviet MiG-21F-13 (FISHBED) with USAF and USN fighters through F-4, F-105, F-106, F-8, and A-6 engagement tests, mission summaries, and tactical recommendations.
